script: [hook] Want to actually learn a language this year? || Here's the whole plan, start to finish. || First, the vision. Speak Spanish for ten minutes by June. That's your finish line. || Then three milestones. Learn your first five hundred words. Finish the A1 course. And have your first real conversation. || [turn] Now take the middle one, and break it into small actions. A short lesson every day, shadow one podcast episode, and book a call with a tutor. || You don't need a whole study system. You just need one thing, done today. || [land] Do today's lesson, and then watch the whole plan move. || [outro] That's the kind of plan Dmyor is built around. || [outro] And if you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
